Name: Erik Czerny
Description: Erik was a brilliant scientist and strategist. The country of Myridia was to be his own inherited from his father General Tibor Czerny. Erik became obsessed with "the Shadows", a small circle of invisible potentates who truly run the world. Convinced that the political and social crises of recent years had been engineered by that Cabal, Erik disappeared in a foolhardy attempt to expose the Shadows.
